test the AgentEventJudge event_time_checker with EQUAL, LESS_THAN, or GREATER_THAN comparators and tolerance windows
test the AgentEventJudge compare method to validate end-to-end event comparison with time and tool checks
test the resolve_arg_placeholders function to resolve placeholder arguments in event actions
test the AgentEventFilter class to filter valid agent write events from simulation
test the EnvAgentEventFilter class to filter environment and user events from simulation
test the parameter_descr function to format action parameters into readable descriptions
test the BulletEventDescription class to generate bullet-point event descriptions with tool names and arguments
test the InContextJudge class initialization and call method to validate agent events against oracle events using LLM-based evaluation
test the GraphPerEventJudge class initialization and call method to validate agent events by matching them against oracle events using hard and soft tool judges
test the InContextJudge initialize_state method to set up judge state from a benchmark scenario with oracle events and tasks
test the GraphPerEventJudge check_tool_call_counts method to verify agent and oracle tool call counters match within allowed tolerances
test the GraphPerEventJudge match_oracle_event method to match oracle events against agent events using event type specific judges
build a dictionary of LLMChecker instances for signature, sanity, content, email, message, event, and tone validation using an LLM engine
create an LLMFunction that formats Jinja prompt templates and calls an LLM engine with system, user, and optional example messages
create an LLMChecker that runs an LLM judge multiple times and returns True if the majority of responses contain the success string
build an LLMFunction subtask extractor for a given tool name, selecting the appropriate prompt template for calendar events, user messages, or generic tools
test an LLMChecker with multiple votes to verify majority-based success or failure decisions using custom success and failure marker strings
validate that a Scenario object has required attributes like oracle_run_event_log and event_id_to_turn_idx
extract task messages from a Scenario's oracle run event log mapped by turn index
extract the user's full name from a Scenario's contacts app
extract agent events from an Environment's event log up to a given turn index
run a Scenario in oracle mode using an Environment and capture the event log
test HardToolJudge.compare to validate agent tool call arguments match oracle using eq_checker and unordered_list_checker
test SoftToolJudge.compare to validate agent tool call content using LLM-based soft checkers like content_checker and tone_checker
test MildToolJudge.compare to validate agent tool calls by combining HardToolJudge and SoftToolJudge in sequence
test CheckerType enum values like eq_checker, phone_number_checker, and path_checker for hard validation strategies
test SoftCheckerType enum values like placeholder_checker, signature_checker, and email_checker for LLM-based soft validation
